{"schema_version":"4.3-requirement-extraction-v3.1.1","task_type":"requirement_extraction","status":"success","data":{"requirements":[{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S003","start_ref":"C005-S003"},"text":"投标文件必须按招标文件要求签署、盖章。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S005","start_ref":"C005-S004"},"text":"投标人必须具备招标文件中规定的资格要求，并提供格式条款《关于资格的声明函》承诺书，不得对该承诺书作实质性修改。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S006","start_ref":"C005-S006"},"text":"投标报价不得超过招标文件中规定的预算金额或者最高限价。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S007","start_ref":"C005-S007"},"text":"投标文件不得含有采购人不能接受的附加条件。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S008","start_ref":"C005-S008"},"text":"投标文件必须按规定的期限、地点送达。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S010","start_ref":"C005-S009"},"text":"投标文件内容必须实质性响应并符合法律法规和招标文件中规定的其它实质性要求。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S011","start_ref":"C005-S011"},"text":"投标文件中同一方案不得有选择性报价，如有则必须声明以哪一个为准。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S012","start_ref":"C005-S012"},"text":"投标人必须响应招标文件中的付款方式。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S013","start_ref":"C005-S013"},"text":"投标人必须通过江阴市公共资源交易平台会员系统确认参加投标。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S016","start_ref":"C005-S015"},"text":"投标单位不得直接或间接从采购人或采购代理机构处获得其他投标单位的投标情况，并修改其投标文件。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S018","start_ref":"C005-S017"},"text":"评审活动开始前，投标单位不得直接或间接从采购人或采购代理机构处获得评标委员会组成人员情况。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S019","start_ref":"C005-S019"},"text":"投标单位不得接受采购人或采购代理机构授意撤换、修改投标文件。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S020","start_ref":"C005-S020"},"text":"投标单位之间不得协商投标报价、技术方案等投标文件实质性内容。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S021","start_ref":"C005-S021"},"text":"属于同一集团、协会、商会等组织成员的投标单位不得按照该组织要求协同投标。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S022","start_ref":"C005-S022"},"text":"投标单位之间不得事先约定由某一特定投标单位中标。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S023","start_ref":"C005-S023"},"text":"投标单位之间不得商定部分投标单位放弃投标或者放弃中标。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S025","start_ref":"C005-S024"},"text":"投标单位与采购人或采购代理机构之间、投标单位相互之间不得为谋求特定投标单位中标成交或者排斥其他投标单位而实施其他串通行为。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S026","start_ref":"C005-S026"},"text":"不同投标人的投标文件不得由同一单位或者个人编制。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S027","start_ref":"C005-S027"},"text":"不同投标人不得委托同一单位或者个人办理投标事宜。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S030","start_ref":"C005-S030"},"text":"不同投标人的投标文件载明的项目管理成员不得为同一人。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S031","start_ref":"C005-S031"},"text":"不同投标人的投标文件不得异常一致或者投标报价不得呈规律性差异。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S032","start_ref":"C005-S032"},"text":"不同投标人的投标文件不得相互混装。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S036","start_ref":"C005-S036"},"text":"投标人未参加开标的，视同认可开标结果。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S041","start_ref":"C005-S040"},"text":"投标人必须提供投标文件组成中的资格证明文件（文件1-文件2），以确定是否具备投标资格。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S044","start_ref":"C005-S042"},"text":"投标供应商在投标截止时间之前不得被列入失信被执行人、重大税收违法失信主体、政府采购严重违法失信行为记录名单；联合体成员存在不良信用记录的，视同联合体存在不良信用记录。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S054","start_ref":"C005-S054"},"text":"投标文件必须有投标单位法定代表人或授权委托人签字和加盖公章。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S055","start_ref":"C005-S055"},"text":"投标文件载明的采购项目的完成期限不得超过招标文件规定的期限。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S056","start_ref":"C005-S056"},"text":"投标文件不得严重背离招标文件中确定的技术功能要求。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S057","start_ref":"C005-S057"},"text":"投标文件不得附有采购人不能接受的商务条件。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S058","start_ref":"C005-S058"},"text":"投标文件必须符合招标文件中规定的其他实质性要求。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S064","start_ref":"C005-S062"},"text":"投标文件必须实质上响应招标文件的要求；投标人不得通过修正或撤消不合要求的偏离或保留使其投标成为实质上响应的投标。"},{"category":"other","mandatory_observed":true,"requires_confirmation":false,"source_range":{"end_ref":"C005-S072","start_ref":"C005-S067"},"text":"对于投标文件中含义不明确、同类问题表述不一致或者有明显文字和计算错误的内容，投标人应当按照评标委员会的要求以书面形式作出必要的澄清、说明或者补正；澄清、说明或者补正应当采用书面形式，并加盖公章，或者由法定代表人或其授权委托人签字，且不得超出投标文件的范围或者改变投标文件的实质性内容。"}]},"warnings":[]}
